info.description: Identity (sign in, current user, user creation) and scheduling (availability, booking with Idempotency-Key, cancellation).
info.title: MedicalBooking API

get.description: A patient sees own appointments; a doctor with a doctor profile sees appointments of his or her agenda; any other caller gets 403. Ordered by slot start, then id. Rows carry no patient data.

403.description: Caller is neither a patient nor a doctor with an agenda

get.summary: List own appointments, or the doctor's agenda

post.description: Idempotent: repeating the same Idempotency-Key and body returns the original appointment (200). Reusing the key with a different body returns 409. A new reservation returns 201.

403.description: Caller has no patient profile

404.description: Schedule slot or medical service not found

409.description: Slot already taken, or key reused with another request

422.description: Invalid body, missing key or slot already started

post.summary: Reserve a schedule slot

403.description: Appointment not found or not owned by the caller

409.description: Appointment can no longer be cancelled

post.summary: Cancel an own appointment and release its slot

post.description: Returns a short-lived bearer token. Unknown emails and wrong passwords return the same problem.
post.summary: Sign in with email and password

post.description: Always answers 202 with the same message, whether or not the email already has an account. The account stays inactive until the link sent by email is opened.

422.description: Invalid request body or weak password

get.description: The token is single use and expires after 24 hours.

422.description: Link invalid, already used, or expired

422.description: Invalid body or unknown test type

get.description: Read-only. Nothing is stored and the decision is not modified (modo SOMBRA, modifica_decision is always false).

200.description: Shadow findings for anemia, iron and diabetes

403.description: Caller lacks the permission or is not the owner

get.summary: Read the shadow findings of an order (ordering doctor)

post.description: Explicit action of the ordering doctor. Each call creates a new snapshot with the evidence (result id, value, unit) of each finding. Snapshots are never updated or deleted. The decision is not modified.

403.description: Caller lacks the permission or is not the owner

post.summary: Store an immutable snapshot of the shadow findings

get.description: Same access as the shadow read: resultados.leer_con_acceso and ownership by the ordering doctor. A missing order, snapshot or finding answers the same 403. Read-only; every read is audited.

403.description: Caller lacks resultados.leer_con_acceso, is not the ordering doctor, or the snapshot or finding does not exist for this order

get.summary: Append-only edit history of one shadow finding

post.description: Appends one physician action on one finding of an immutable snapshot (CONFIRMAR, DESCARTAR or MODIFICAR). A reason is mandatory. The snapshot and the suggestion are never changed. Requires revisiones.registrar and ownership of the order.

403.description: Caller lacks the permission or is not the owner

404.description: Snapshot or finding not found for this order

422.description: Invalid action, category or missing reason

post.summary: Physician confirms, discards or modifies a shadow finding

get.summary: Read the authenticated user, roles and permissions

put.description: Self-reported data for the WHO 2024 haemoglobin adjustments. Altitude and smoking are mandatory; a smoker declares cigarettes per day. Only the patient writes it.

403.description: Caller lacks the permission or is not the owner

422.description: Invalid altitude, smoking or cigarette count

put.summary: Declare own altitude of residence and smoking (patient)

post.description: Reserves one pending payment attempt, opens a Stripe Checkout Session and returns its URL. The invoice is paid only when the verified webhook confirms the session; a redirect never confirms payment.

parameters.description: 8 to 100 characters. The same key with the same invoice returns the same checkout; the same key with another invoice answers 409.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

200.description: Replay of the same key and invoice

403.description: Not the owner, or the invoice does not exist

409.description: Invoice not pending, or the key belongs to another invoice

503.description: Payment provider not configured or unavailable

post.summary: Start a Stripe Checkout for an invoice (owner only)

post.description: Verifies the Stripe-Signature header over the raw body (HMAC-SHA256, v1, 5 minute tolerance), records the event once and confirms, rejects or cancels the matching checkout payment. Payments are never confirmed by a browser redirect.

400.description: Missing, stale or invalid signature, or a malformed event

503.description: Webhook secret not configured; the endpoint fails closed

post.summary: Receive a signed Stripe event
